answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Decay. Each new wallet inherits a reputation seed derived from its operator's shared infrastructure fingerprint (IP ranges, funding paths, timing patterns). A sparrow of activity across many wallets creates a mirror of the same operator, flagged by a cross-wallet correlation signal. Enforcement: when correlation exceeds threshold, every wallet tied to that operator loses reputation proportional to cluster size, and new wallets from that operator start at negative seed. Cost: an attacker must rebuild distinct infrastructure per identity.
